title: A Foundation Model for Policy In-Context Longitudinal Causal Effect Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2610.32863v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Longitudinal causal effect estimation is complicated by time-varying confounding and treatment-confounder feedback loops. Existing methods generally require data-specific nuisance-model fitting, and many are tailored to prespecified treatment sequences or prediction horizons, leading to time-consuming computation at deployment. We introduce *Policy In-Context Longitudinal causal Effect estimation with Prior-data Fitted Networks* (**PICLE-PFN**), the first foundation model for longitudinal causal effect estimation that supports *dynamic* treatment policies. PICLE-PFN represents target policies through in-context history-decision demonstrations, providing a unified interface for a broad class of treatment policies. Pretrained over synthetic data sampled from longitudinal structural causal models, PICLE-PFN amortizes causal effect estimation across datasets, policies, and horizons. translated_title: 面向策略上下文纵向因果效应估计的基础模型
translated_abstract: 纵向因果效应估计因时变混杂因素以及治疗与混杂因素之间的反馈回路而变得复杂。现有方法通常需要针对特定数据进行干扰模型拟合，且许多方法是针对预先设定的治疗序列或预测时间范围定制的，导致部署时计算耗时。我们提出了基于先验数据拟合网络的策略上下文纵向因果效应估计（**PICLE-PFN**），这是第一个支持*动态*治疗策略的纵向因果效应估计基础模型。PICLE-PFN 通过上下文中的历史-决策示例来表示目标策略，为广泛的治疗策略类别提供了统一的接口。PICLE-PFN 在从纵向结构因果模型中采样的合成数据上进行预训练，将因果效应估计摊销到不同数据集、策略和时间范围上。给定一个新的观测数据集和目标策略，它可以直接估计……
tldr: 本文提出了首个支持动态治疗策略的纵向因果效应估计基础模型 PICLE-PFN，通过在合成数据上预训练并以上下文学习方式表示目标策略，将因果效应估计的计算摊销到不同数据集、策略和预测范围上，避免了部署时耗时的模型拟合。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PICLE-PFN, the first foundation model for longitudinal causal effect estimation that supports dynamic treatment policies by representing them through in-context history-decision demonstrations, and amortizes causal effect estimation across datasets, policies, and horizons via pretraining on synthetic data.
